dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: #It doesn't if {M#he's}{F#she's} willing to join us. But... It would seem that {NICKNAME} hasn't quite grasped the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: In short, we're playing a "Tabletop Troupe" script. In it, everyone takes on the role of a character.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: For example... Navia is a "Marechaussee Hunter," Jahoda is a "Master of Qi," and Illuga is a "Lochknight"...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh, don't fret! The rules are really simple. Just follow along and have fun, you'll catch on in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If we wait any longer, those explosives are gonna blast us all sky-high!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Hmm. Well then... Due to various factors, I'll set the difficulty of this game to "Easy Mode."

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Now then, choose the "skill" for the character you'll be playing.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Very well. In that case, you want to learn the "cooking" skill, yes?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Very well. In that case, you wish to learn the "medicine" skill, yes?
